fields.name: Orleans Runtime Query Catalog
fields.responsibility: Names the stored procedure behind every operation the Orleans runtime tables perform — membership insert, update, read, liveness and defunct cleanup, gateway lookup, and reminder read, upsert and delete — and bundles the reminder trio into the per-grain-type registration shape. It is the single declaration of the database contract an ArgentSea-hosted Orleans cluster expects, which both the cluster store and the reminder store draw on.
